dataset.name: APTOS 2019
dataset.split_method: stratified on grade, group-aware (exact + near-duplicate photos kept together), seed 42
dataset.limitation: APTOS 2019 provides no patient/eye identifiers, so patient-level (left/right eye) separation could not be enforced; only exact/near-duplicate image grouping was used. Test results may be optimistic if both eyes of a patient are present.

quality.note: degradation detection rates measure sensitivity to SYNTHETIC defects only; there are no genuine quality labels (e.g. EyeQ) here.

gradcam.note: Spearman between trained-model and weight-randomised Grad-CAM maps on 3 images; values near 0 mean the map depends on learned weights. Not a proof of lesion localisation.

latency.note: forward pass on random tensors (timing only); preprocessing timed on one real image; excludes disk read and Grad-CAM.

ablation.name: EfficientNet-B0 + quality gate (rejected counted as referred)
ablation.notes: conservative accounting; AUC/QWK not defined for the decision pipeline

ablation.name: EfficientNet-B0 + quality gate + human-review band (both counted as referred)
ablation.notes: conservative accounting; AUC/QWK not defined for the decision pipeline

ablation_notes: All rows are evaluated on the identical internal test split. Lesion-evidence and lesion/CNN fusion rows are absent because no lesion detector was implemented (no lesion annotations in APTOS). 'Fusion' here means quality gate + confidence-based review band only.

decision.rule: see scripts/compare_robust.py docstring (fixed before the results were seen)

robust_run.stop_reason: early stopping: no improvement in validation qwk for 8 epochs

robustness_comparison.caveat: degradations are synthetic and applied to full-resolution originals; the training augmentations were applied to 384-px images, so transfer is not guaranteed

segmentation_idrid_test.dataset: IDRiD official segmentation test split (27 images)
segmentation_idrid_test.evaluation_type: held-out test of the lesion model (images never used for training or selection)
segmentation_idrid_test.metric_notes: pixel-level on the 1280-px retina canvas; Dice == pixel F1; thresholds chosen on validation images

locator_idrid_test.note: errors in ORIGINAL IDRiD pixels (4288x2848 images); DD = median optic-disc diameter measured on validation masks

locator_final_idrid_test.note: final estimate = segmented disc + regressor fovea if consistent, else anatomical prior; errors in original IDRiD pixels

idrid.license: CC BY 4.0 (Porwal et al., IDRiD, Data 2018;3(3):25); this run used a third-party Kaggle copy of the official release
idrid.note: A missing mask file is interpreted as 'no lesion of that type in the image' (dataset convention).

aptos_features.note: lesion models applied to APTOS WITHOUT any APTOS lesion annotation: domain transfer from IDRiD, performance on APTOS lesions is unmeasured

lesion_fusion.protocol: rule thresholds, GB grader on TRAIN rows; fusion weight + thresholds on VALIDATION rows; test touched once

fusion.note: w=1.0 means the validation set preferred the classifier alone

rows.name: Lesion rules alone (data-calibrated (fitted on training split))
Classifier + lesion-evidence escalation (data-calibrated (fitted on training split))

external_idrid.evaluation_type: EXTERNAL (never used for training or selection of the classifier or rule thresholds)

_method.note: images treated as independent; no patient grouping available

rows.name: Lesion rules alone (data-calibrated (fitted on training split))

dme_proxy.definition: hard-exudate regions within 1 disc diameter of the estimated fovea vs IDRiD macular-oedema risk >= 1

ensemble_selection.protocol: selected on VALIDATION mean(QWK, ROC-AUC); test only reported + non-inferiority vs default; IDRiD independent

caveats: EyePACS grades are noisier than APTOS/IDRiD (single-reader labels from varied sites).
The IDRiD check has n = 100: its intervals are wide, so rule (b) is a weak guard rather than proof.
The robust baseline never saw EyePACS, so its EyePACS-test numbers are an external-domain result for it only.

eophtha_test_v2.note: only MA and EX are annotated in e-ophtha; thresholds chosen on validation images

decision.rule: see scripts/compare_lesion_v2.py (fixed before the results were seen)
